verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a cloud platform and its CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control for the Console, CLI, or SDKs. The CLI, SDK, IAM, billing and free-tier items are about other features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
